issues.on_page: Total Non-Major Funds column: receipts 624,626, disbursements 1,042,721 (p7)
issues.issue: The extractor rule says a combining schedule with more than 6 fund columns uses its Total column (fund 'Nonmajor funds (combined)'). The per-fund rule of 2026-10-27 covers only cities and villages. The per-fund lines tie to the Total column and nothing is double counted.
'Local' is a broad group that mixes fees, interest income and miscellaneous receipts. Charges are probably the dominant part. The line already has a review note.
